slash.name: Slash
slash.desc: Heavy sword sweep (1.1× ATK) — slow, reaching just past the blade.

powerStrike.name: Somersault Smash
powerStrike.desc: Leap into a somersault, then crash down with a heavy ground smash (1.8× ATK, 0.6s stun) and one forward piercing shockwave (1.5× ATK). Other skills are locked during the flip.

groundSlam.name: Ground Slam
groundSlam.desc: Wind up, then a double somersault that cuts twice (1.5× ATK) into a heavy all-around ground slam (1.5× ATK) — radial AoE (both sides) + triple shockwave ring (1.16× ATK each).

rush.name: Rush
rush.desc: Dash forward ~200px, pierce enemies: 1.2× ATK to each foe passed, plus 5 flame bursts (1.5× ATK, 60px).

warCry.name: War Cry
warCry.desc: +55% ATK and +25% DEF for 7s — also rallies co-op partners on your map. Battle roar taunts foes within 340px + shock-pulses those within 180px for 1.2× ATK.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.desc: 20 s rage (+30% ATK, +speed) — shared with co-op partners on your map. Casting also restores 20% of your max HP and MP. While active, basic Z attacks launch forward piercing shockwaves (0.9× ATK).

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: Ultimate: 3.5s spinning AoE (8 radial pulses, 0.8× ATK, 220px) with +80% ATK and a 0.8× ATK close pulse every second.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.desc: +20% DEF + 20% damage reflect for 30s, +2% to both per rank. Rank 5: +10s and +2% DEF; rank 10: +30s and +5% DEF instead. The +DEF also shields co-op partners on your map.

holyShield.name: Holy Shield
holyShield.desc: Ultimate: 2.5s invulnerability + 5s 50% damage reflect + three holy waves (2× ATK each). Shares the shield with co-op partners on your map.

warlord_warcry.name: Warlord's Banner
warlord_warcry.desc: 12s banner planted on the field: War Cry + Bloodlust (+85% ATK), 25% heal, and +50% reach on melee swings and area bursts. Plants with a 2.2× ATK burst + 3 piercing shockwaves (2.5× ATK). Rallies co-op partners on your map (War Cry + Bloodlust + heal).

doombringer_apoc.name: Blade of Calamity
doombringer_apoc.desc: Summon a colossal sword: 10 forward cleaves (2× ATK each, the last a sure crit) over ~1.4s, with a 3× ATK ground slam midway. Every hit brands foes with DOOM (+2% damage taken per stack, max 10) and stokes Calamity Heat.

crusader_aegis.name: Divine Aegis
crusader_aegis.desc: Heal 60% (co-op partners on your map too) + 5 hovering holy orbs strike nearby foes (3× ATK, each orb once per second) · HALF damage taken for 9s.

dragoon_skylance.name: Sky Lance
dragoon_skylance.desc: Warp above the nearest foe on screen and dive, punching through one platform, for an 8× ATK slam (340px, ×1.6 vs bosses) that stuns foes for 0.8s — then a second dive re-targets and lands ~0.7s later (only while prey remains). Rank 10 adds a third dive.

warlord_ult.name: War of Banners
warlord_ult.desc: Enter a 10s enrage (Bloodlust, shared with co-op partners on your map) that heals 25% of your max HP and refunds its own MP cost; every press is a 4× ATK sweep plus a piercing banner wave (3.3× ATK) — re-press B for free, rapid banner strikes.

doombringer_ult.name: Calamity Incarnate
doombringer_ult.desc: Name one foe — boss first, else the biggest health pool — and drop the verdict on it: a 5× ATK melee cleave, then SEVEN homing doom-fires (3× ATK each) that all converge on that single target (~26x ATK total, ~52x at full heat). Each fire re-brands with DOOM. Collects up to 10 DOOM brands from the map (from rank 5, each adds +1% execute threshold and +0.4s window) and burns all Calamity Heat (+1% damage per point).

crusader_ult.name: Bastion of Dawn
crusader_ult.desc: Tap once to ARM (free), tap again to RELEASE — the cooldown starts at release. While armed the Bastion stores DAWN CHARGE: it grows the longer you hold (full at 10s) and with every point of damage you take (full at one max HP). Release DAWNBREAK: foes are drawn in, then a holy detonation for 3.5× ATK, up to 31.5× fully charged, in a radius that grows with the charge (300 to 600px), plus two wider after-waves of 0.75× ATK each (up to 6.75×) — and a full party heal with a 15s half-damage shield for everyone. Armed for 15s, then it erupts on its own.

dragoon_ult.name: Skyfall Dominion
dragoon_ult.desc: Leap skyward and call down 9 piercing dragon-lances (5.5× ATK each) that fall on foes within 900px (or rain around you if none), then crash down in a 460px shockwave (2.7× ATK, ×1.3 vs bosses).

stab.name: Stab
stab.desc: Lightning dagger slash (0.68× ATK) — a quick close arc reaching 144 px, the fastest basic attack.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: Blink behind the nearest foe within 280 px + 2-stab crit combo (1× ATK each) and +0.5× crit damage for 2.5 s. No target: 3 forward thrusts at 1× ATK.

throwDagger.name: Shuriken
throwDagger.desc: 5-lane shuriken fan at 0.5× ATK each (up to 6 with multishot), with a leap that refreshes your air jump.

smokeDash.name: Smoke Dash
smokeDash.desc: 220 px dash through a 3-lane corridor (0.6× ATK on your line, 0.43× above/below) + 3 smoke ticks at 0.3× ATK. 50% chance to dodge attacks while dashing (no longer fully invulnerable).

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Blink-warp 360 px forward, slashing every foe in the corridor for 1.8× ATK — 50% chance to evade attacks while warping. Press again within 6 s to warp back, slashing the path again.

shadowStrike.name: Shadow Strike
shadowStrike.desc: Chain-teleport through 5 strikes at 1.3× ATK each — with fewer foes in range, the same ones are struck again.

deathBlossom.name: Death Blossom
deathBlossom.desc: Ultimate: hyper-jump somersault forward, then 3 fast spinning waves of 1.75× ATK (up to 12 foes within 320 px each). Movement speed + speed cap DOUBLE for 1.6 s.

smokeBomb.name: Shin-Shuriken
smokeBomb.desc: Double somersault — two fans of 5 kunai + 2 shuriken each (3 shuriken at rank 5, 4 at rank 10), 0.38× ATK per blade, that spread out from your chest.

sleight.name: Voidrift Blink
sleight.desc: Assassin V: 3-charge zip across half the screen — tap to blink, hitting all foes in the path for 3× ATK (×1.15 / ×1.3 on the 2nd / 3rd charge). Cooldown starts after the 3rd charge.

shadowlord_clones.name: Mirror Shadow
shadowlord_clones.desc: 3 levitating clones plant above you and 320 px to either side — each strikes a 110 px circle for 1.1× ATK every 0.4 s for 11s, then they SHATTER in a triple shadow nova (4× ATK, 270 px). While they stand, press again (10 MP) to BLINK to the next clone.

shinobi_seal.name: Kage Rush
shinobi_seal.desc: 4 charges. Each is a short shadow-step slash (~400 px) across a crimson lane, dealing 4× ATK to every foe it crosses — chain them, then the seal recharges.

nightreaper_mark.name: Eclipse Massacre
nightreaper_mark.desc: Blink to the centre of the screen and hover, pinned for the first 1.2 s while a blood-eclipse rains spectral daggers (0.9× ATK) in 10 batches on every enemy under the moon, staggering them. You are free to move for the second half; at 2.5 s the eclipse snaps shut for a stunning 1.86× ATK aftershock nova and heals 14% max HP. No prey in reach refunds 30 MP instead.

phantom_cut.name: Voidrift Execution
phantom_cut.desc: Mark up to 6 enemies within 900 px and execute them in 6 chain-teleport strikes (5.2× ATK each); the final hit detonates a stunning shadow nova (2.6× ATK, 220 px) and restores 15% of your max HP. No prey in reach refunds 30 MP.

shadowlord_ult.name: Shadow Sovereign
shadowlord_ult.desc: Summon your Sovereign Shade: a shadow of yourself that mirrors your every move — run, jump, strike — a beat behind for 20s, and echoes every hit you land as a second strike at 85% damage.

shinobi_ult.name: Hundred-Hand Shadow Dance
shinobi_ult.desc: Four blink-slashes (5× ATK in 175 px each) that stick to the nearest foe, then a 6× ATK shockwave finale (330 px) that returns you to where you started.

nightreaper_ult.name: Bloodmoon Domain
nightreaper_ult.desc: Three waves of 9 homing, piercing shuriken (1× ATK each), an execute on non-boss foes under 25% HP, then a 3.8× ATK blood nova (380 px). Your next 60 crit rolls are guaranteed.

phantom_ult.name: Voidwalk
phantom_ult.desc: Vault into a void somersault and loose three rings of 12 piercing void shards (3.5× ATK each).

magicBolt.name: Magic Bolt
magicBolt.desc: Arcane projectile (1.1× ATK + 6) that flies straight ~300px; 25% chance to freeze the target for 0.8s. Free to cast.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: Fireball (2.29× ATK + 12) that explodes on impact or after ~250px (190 px radius, 70% splash; 75% chance to ignite the target).

iceSpike.name: Ice Spike
iceSpike.desc: 3 ice spikes (4 at rank 5, 5 at rank 10), 1.1× ATK each and 55% splash within 90px; 50% chance to freeze for 1.5s on hit. Rank 10: each spike also pierces 1 foe.

blink.name: Dimensional Warp
blink.desc: Phase 225px across a dimension (180px when warping skyward). Deals 2.1× ATK to every monster in the path traversed (+100×50 px AoE around it). Hold ↑ while casting (or double-tap ↑) to warp skyward.

arcaneBurst.name: Arcane Burst
arcaneBurst.desc: Massive 320-px AoE explosion centred on you (3× ATK, heavy knockback).

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: Call a meteor down 80px ahead of you: it strikes every foe it falls through for 4× ATK + 80, then bursts about 140px wide where it lands.

elemental.name: Elemental Convergence
elemental.desc: Ultimate: lightning chains through up to 8 enemies (2.5× ATK + 80, −8% per hop), stunning each for 1.2s with a 75% chance to burn (0.737× ATK/tick for 3s).

soulSiphon.name: Soul Siphon
soulSiphon.desc: Drain nearby foes (0.25× ATK) into MP and HP, raise 1 undead thrall (skeleton or zombie, 16s, hits for 75% of your ATK) from the first victim, and call up soul orbs (2 to start, +1 every 1.5s, max 5) that orbit you for 12s and hunt — each homes into a foe within 380px and detonates (1× ATK + 10).

darkPulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkPulse.desc: Ultimate: void AoE around you (220px, 1× ATK), then summon 3 undead that hunt across the map for 30s — each hitting for 35% of your ATK, and killable by monsters.

holyLight.name: Holy Light
holyLight.desc: Self-heal 25–100% maxHP and restore up to 60 MP (both scale with ATK) + holy AoE (2.1× ATK, 650×440). +1 Prism Charge (max 5). Co-op partners on your map are healed too.

celestialAurora.name: Celestial Aurora
celestialAurora.desc: 10s celestial field (550×100) — heals you 15% HP+MP/sec while you stand in it (co-op partners on your map wherever they are), holy DoT to enemies inside (1× ATK/sec), cleanse on cast. Consumes Prism Charges (+5% per charge).

archbishop_grail.name: Judgment of the Holy Grail
archbishop_grail.desc: Ascend (0.8s guard), rain 7 holy pillars on the highest-HP foe within 520px (3.8× ATK each); each hit refunds 3% max MP. Co-op partners on your map heal 25% HP and 15% MP.

sage_meteorshower.name: Pyre Columns
sage_meteorshower.desc: Five fire columns erupt from the ground ahead of you in rapid succession - each pillar 6x ATK across a 190px lane (weaker at its edges), launching foes skyward.

elementalist_cascade.name: Prismatic Cascade
elementalist_cascade.desc: Four elements in sequence: a Pyre column on the nearest foe ahead (3.5× ATK, burn), a Frost nova around you (300px, 3× ATK, freeze), a Storm chain of up to 4 hops (3.5× ATK + 23 each, stun), then the Void convergence - a 340px blast (2.5× ATK) that grows +25% for every element that connected.

necromancer_harvest.name: Soul Vortex
necromancer_harvest.desc: Open a 30s vortex pool that drags enemies in and drains 1.2× ATK/sec (30% returned to you as HP). Recast to move the pool wherever the fight goes.

hexmaster_grandhex.name: Grand Hex
hexmaster_grandhex.desc: Hex everything inside the 520px rune ring: 1.2s freeze (non-boss), a 2.5× ATK burst, and a stacking curse DOT (0.35× ATK/tick per stack) that also makes the target take +4% damage per stack. 1.5s later the ring PULSES AGAIN (2× ATK) and stacks EVERYONE inside, so one cast is worth 2 stacks; at 5 it RUPTURES for 2× ATK and splashes 50% onto neighbours, infecting them as well. A hexed foe's curse jumps to its nearest neighbour when it dies. Also looses 3 hex orbs (7s) that strike up to 3 times each (1× ATK + a stack).

sage_ult.name: Meteor Sigil
sage_ult.desc: Open an 8s sigil: tap B up to 10 times to hurl homing comets (4.2x ATK + 110, explode on impact for 70% splash) at the nearest foes AHEAD of you. Each tap refunds its MP; the cooldown starts when the window closes (10th comet or 8s).

elementalist_ult.name: Elemental Apotheosis
elementalist_ult.desc: Three catastrophes, then the cooldown: each press sends a 1.5× ATK nova around you and unleashes one of four random elemental catastrophes - INFERNO (a rolling 7.5× ATK firestorm that explodes through the pack), GLACIAL CATACLYSM (a 7× ATK comet onto the nearest foe ahead that shatters and freezes for 2s), THUNDERFALL (a 7.2× ATK thunder spear across the whole screen) or SINGULARITY (a slow 8× ATK void sphere that hits everything in its path). Three different ones per cast; only the third starts the cooldown. The first strike pays the MP, the other two are free.

necromancer_ult.name: Necrotic Ascendance
necromancer_ult.desc: Become a soul maelstrom for 6s - drag foes in, drain them twice a second (0.6x ATK each, heals you); every soul harvested feeds the final collapse (3.5x ATK +0.35x per soul, up to 9x). Half damage taken while it storms; with a Soul Vortex open the storm anchors INTO the pool instead of walking with you.

hexmaster_ult.name: Pandemic Hex
hexmaster_ult.desc: Unleash a contagious curse: a 3.2× ATK blast, freeze + WEAKEN (−35% enemy ATK for 9s, bosses included), three 1.2× ATK pulses, then a 3s doom that erupts for 2×–4× ATK — the deeper the hexes on cursed foes, the bigger. Summons 10 dark hex orbs (1× ATK) that hunt, burst, land a hex stack each, and afflict SUPER POISON (0.9× ATK/tick). While the plague runs, a dying foe's curse infects EVERY neighbour in range, not just the nearest.

archbishop_ult.name: Apotheosis
archbishop_ult.desc: 5s of invulnerability and five holy pulses (6× ATK, +6% HP each) that build to a 3.2× ATK judgment nova, healing you to full. Co-op partners on your map are healed too.

arrowShot.name: Arrow Shot
arrowShot.desc: Fire an arrow for 1.05× ATK. Each shot builds Steady Aim: +9% damage per shot, up to +40%.

multiShot.name: Multi Shot
multiShot.desc: 3 arrow spread, 1.1× ATK + 3 per arrow. Rank 10: each arrow pierces 1 foe.

chargedShot.name: Charged Shot
chargedShot.desc: Big charged arrow — heavy 1.8× ATK + 10 burst; pierces 2 foes (3 at rank 10).

evadeRoll.name: Evade Burst
evadeRoll.desc: Back flip + 2 explosive shots (1.1× ATK + 8 each) + cute 130 px blast (1.1× ATK + 8) that hugely knocks back nearby monsters. 50% chance to evade attacks for 0.4 s during the roll.

eagleEye.name: Eagle Eye
eagleEye.desc: +20% crit chance for 30s — also sharpens co-op partners on your map — plus +18 Steady Aim, and a point-blank burst (1.5× ATK, 120 px) knocks foes in front of you back.

snipe_railgun.name: Railshot
snipe_railgun.desc: Instant piercing rail along the facing direction — hits every foe in a flat line up to 900 px for 2× ATK + 3, with an extra 40% crit roll. Each consecutive hit empowers the next (+30% per foe). HOLD to overcharge: up to +150% damage and a rail that carries 700 px further.

arrowRain.name: Arrow Rain
arrowRain.desc: Ultimate: Rain 22 arrows (1.75× ATK each) over ~1 s onto a 320 px area 200 px ahead of you.

wildBond.name: Wild Bond
wildBond.desc: Summon a hardy wolf companion that bites for 0.8× ATK every 1.5 s. 60s timer OR 15× your max HP, whichever runs out first.

elementalArrows.name: Elemental Arrows
elementalArrows.desc: Ultimate: Barrage of 10 piercing magic arrows, 2× ATK + 5 each, with a 75% chance to burn.

marksman_oneshot.name: Deadeye
marksman_oneshot.desc: FOCUS FIRE — opens a 6s window and locks on to one foe in front of you (bosses first). Every press inside it is free and pours guaranteed-crit lines into that foe, 0.75× ATK + 10 each: 3 lines, then 4, 5, 6 and 7 on consecutive presses (pause for 1s and it drops back to 3). Nothing else is hit. The cooldown starts when the window closes.

ballista_volley.name: Siege Volley
ballista_volley.desc: One press unleashes an 8 s piercing arrow stream — 2 arrows every 0.15 s (~106 total), 0.535× ATK + 5 each; other skills are locked while it flows. Drains 6 MP/s while active and ends early if MP runs out or you are staggered — no holding needed.

beastmaster_pack.name: Call of the Wild
beastmaster_pack.desc: Summon up to 5 oversized wolves (15× your max HP each, 100 s life) that bite for 0.8× ATK every 1.2 s. Cap is global and shared with your Wild Bond wolf — re-cast tops up to 5.

skyhunter_gale.name: Gale Storm
skyhunter_gale.desc: 15 homing arrows (2× ATK + 5 each) fanned across, each seeking a foe within 900 px.

marksman_ult.name: Deadeye Protocol
marksman_ult.desc: OVERCLOCK — opens an 8s window and locks on to one foe. Every press inside it is free and fires a volley of 5 homing rounds (7 while Deadeye has that foe marked), 0.7× ATK + 12 each, guaranteed crits that hit nothing but the lock. Every 6th volley, and the end of the window, fires an EXECUTE ROUND worth 25% of the volley damage since the last one (at least 0.7× ATK). The cooldown starts when the window closes.

ballista_ult.name: War Machine
ballista_ult.desc: Deploy 1 stationary siege turret that auto-fires homing, piercing arrows (2.1× ATK + 25 every 0.9 s) at foes within 920 px for 45 s.

beastmaster_ult.name: Apex Bond
beastmaster_ult.desc: Bond with an apex werewolf companion (~51s, bites for 2.2× ATK every 1.5 s) and empower yourself — 12 s of Bloodlust (+30% ATK, faster movement) + a 20% max-HP heal, shared with co-op partners on your map.

skyhunter_ult.name: Eye of the Tempest
skyhunter_ult.desc: Summon a storm-eye eagle (~42s) that hovers and fires homing arrows (1× ATK + 10 every 0.6 s) at foes; each arrow pierces twice. The eagle MARKS its prey - every hit on the marked foe strikes +15%.
